definitions.explanation: Able to withstand fire or high heat without burning or collapsing. Used mostly as the first part of compounds for buildings, materials and safes.

examples.japanese: {耐火|たいか}⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐火|たいか}⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧になっている。
examples.english: This wall has a fire-resistant structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都市部|としぶ}→都市部：14549_toshibu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{燃|も}え→燃える：02312_moeru⟧{広|ひろ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耐火|たいか}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In urban areas, fire-resistant construction is required to keep fires from spreading.

notes:
⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to withstand) + ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ (fire), like ⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧ (earthquake-resistant) and ⟦{耐熱|たいねつ}→耐熱：21127_tainetsu⟧ (heat-resistant).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐火|たいか}⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧: fireproof safe
- {耐火|たいか}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: fire-resistant building
- {耐火|たいか}⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧: firebrick
- {耐火性|たいかせい}: fire resistance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧: fire prevention — stopping fires from starting or spreading (⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧, fire drill)
- {不燃|ふねん}: non-combustible (will not burn at all)

Do not confuse with the homophones ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧ (compensation) and ⟦{退化|たいか}→退化：06030_taika⟧ (degeneration).
